# HorizontalStackOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type HorizontalStackOptions = ElementOptions & Partial<Omit<Pick<HorizontalStack, HorizontalStackOwnKey>, 'alignment' | 'widthDistribution' | 'spacing' | 'height'>> & {
    /** Gap between adjacent columns. Accepts a length: `10`, `'4mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`. */
    spacing?: LengthInput;
    /** Fixed row height. Accepts a length: `120`, `'1in'`, or `{ value, unit }`. */
    height?: LengthInput;

    alignment?: HorizontalAlignmentInput;

    /**
```

### `alignment`

```typescript
alignment?: HorizontalAlignmentInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Cross-axis alignment. Accepts `'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'stretch'`.

### `breakAllowed`

```typescript
breakAllowed?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Whether this element can be split across page boundaries. When false, the element is treated as atomic and will be moved to a new page rather than split. If it doesn't fit on a fresh page either, it renders anyway. Default is true.

### `captureName`

```typescript
captureName?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Optional author-supplied name/key surfaced in the layout snapshot. Unset by default; a future capture API can populate it.

### `children`

```typescript
children?: IElement[] | undefined
```

*optional*

Children to add, in order. Sugar over [`HorizontalStack.add`](horizontal-stack.md#add); use `add(child, weight)` directly when a per-child weight is needed.

### `contentDirection`

```typescript
contentDirection?: ContentDirectionInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Inline progression and paragraph base direction; omitted inherits.

### `height`

```typescript
height?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Fixed row height. Accepts a length: `120`, `'1in'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `keepWithNext`

```typescript
keepWithNext?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Keeps this element with the start of its next sibling in vertical flow.

### `margin`

```typescript
margin?: ThicknessInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Margin around this element. Accepts `12`, `[h, v]`, `[l, t, r, b]` or `{ bottom: 12 }`; omitted sides are zero.

### `spacing`

```typescript
spacing?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Gap between adjacent columns. Accepts a length: `10`, `'4mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `widthDistribution`

